prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: WordPress Developer for Short-term Project
We are looking for a WordPress developer for a short-term project. The ideal candidate must have experience in creating and customizing WordPress websites. The primary task is to design and develop a custom WordPress theme for a client. The developer should have experience with HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript. Additionally, experience with various WordPress plugins and APIs is a plus. This project will require approximately 2 hours of work and the developer must be able to complete the project on a tight timeline.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working developer with 7 years of experience building reliable web interfaces and full stack applications. I’m interested in your short-term WordPress project and would be glad to help design and develop a custom theme on a tight timeline.

While my background is centered on JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack development, HTML, and CSS, I’m comfortable working in fast-paced environments where clean implementation and quick turnaround matter. I understand the importance of delivering a WordPress theme that is both functional and easy to maintain, especially when the project scope is focused and time-sensitive.

For this kind of work, I would approach the theme build with attention to structure, responsiveness, and performance. I’m used to working with HTML and CSS carefully, and I can adapt quickly to the needs of a custom WordPress setup. I also value clear communication, which helps make short projects run smoothly and efficiently. If the task involves integrating or adjusting plugin behavior, I’m comfortable collaborating around APIs and technical requirements to get things working correctly.

Because this is an approximately 2-hour project, I would aim to keep the process streamlined and focused on the essential deliverables. My priority would be to understand exactly what the client needs, implement it cleanly, and make sure the result is polished and ready to use without unnecessary back-and-forth. I’m available to move quickly and work within the timeline you’ve described.

If selected, you can expect a developer who is careful, responsive, and committed to delivering quality work even on a short deadline. I’d be happy to discuss the theme structure and the specific functionality you want included so I can get started right away.

What specific design or functionality should the custom WordPress theme include?
